title: One command runs every automated check
user_visible_behavior: `./init.sh` (or `python tools/panel.py check` on Windows) runs the Python unit tests, the JavaScript logic tests and the ES5 syntax check of the panel, and exits non-zero if any fails.
verification: `./init.sh` exits 0 on a clean checkout.
Adding `let x = 1;` to panel/app.js makes the check fail with the file and line.
evidence: 2026-10-30: ./init.sh exit 0 (1 Python test, 1 JS test, ES5 ok on panel/app.js).
2026-10-30: appending 'let x = 1;' to panel/app.js → 'FAIL panel/app.js:2:5 Unexpected token (not ES5)', exit 1.
2026-10-30: with Node removed from PATH → 'JavaScript checks skipped', Python tests run, exit 0.
notes: Node is optional for end users; when missing, JS checks are skipped with a clear message. CI runs everything.
